item.title: Norfolk councillors approve new business strategies for county marinas
item.description: Norfolk County councillors have approved new business strategies for its marinas. At a recent council-in-committee meeting, initial approval was given to plans for the municipally owned Port Dover Harbour and Port Rowan Harbour marinas.
